correctness.rationale: For p≥5 and all n≥0, count R_(p,n)(a) for x³+y³=a mod p^n. Mod p, nonsingular roots at all (x,y)≠(0,0); unit fibres lift with p^(n−1), divisible target nonsingular fibres contribute c_p p^n (c_p=gcd(3,p−1)(p−1)/p). Singular branch with x,y divisible by p exists only if p³|a and contributes p^4 R_(p,n−3)(a/p³), accounting for redundant last digits. Cubic character convolution gives sum of squares S_p, including |Jacobi(χ,χ)|²=p; averaging squared recurrences yields M_n−L_p=p^(−1)(M_(n−3)−L_p), with explicit initial M0/M1/M2 and L_p=1+gamma_p/p+1/p² (gamma=7 or1 mod3). Iterating valuation shells produces F_p(T)=c_p(p^k−1)/(p−1)+p^k B(U), Haar shell mass ≍p^(−3k), and sharp L^s iff 0<s<3. Independent complete convolution of residues for ten tested (p,n) pairs corroborated all exact rational formulas, not a proof for unbounded n,p.
